1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with ample whitespace and well-separated lines.

2.why: No italics or all-caps text appear anywhere, and all copy is short single-sentence lines rather than dense blocks.

3.why: Content is presented in a single narrow mobile-width column with large fields and buttons that remain readable.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Enter the six-digit code delivered to your verified mobile number' are brief and plain, though the 'Multi-factor authentication' heading is mild jargon.

5.why: No examples or placeholder text show the expected format for email, phone number, or the verification code in any field.

6.why: No long block of text appears on any screen; every step requires reading only one short sentence.

7.why: No long codes or secrets are displayed in the observed flow and no copy affordance is offered; the six-digit code must be transcribed from the phone.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is visible on any of the five screens.

9.why: The plain input fields give no visible indication of autofill or password manager support, so this cannot be confirmed or denied from the screenshots.

10.why: Each screen has a clear bold heading naming the current step and a single prominent blue primary button, though there is no explicit step counter.

11.why: Every screen presents exactly one task with one primary action button (Continue or Verify identity).

12.why: The Logs panel records outcomes ('Identity verification delivery was initiated') and the error advises trying again, but the wording is technical and success states are not plainly announced.

13.why: Retry is possible with the entered code retained after the error, but no reveal/hide toggle or resend/re-request code option is visible.

14.why: The error 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' is non-blaming and suggests retrying but never states what the actual problem was.

15.why: No countdown timer or time limit appears on any screen, so no constraint on reading or code entry time is observed.
